nodeData.topic: AI — from first steps to expert
nodeData.note: Learn artificial intelligence in two tracks. Beginner track (no code, no maths): what AI is, chatbots and generative AI, AI at work, safety, ethics and law. Technical track: maths for AI, machine learning, deep learning, hands-on coding and the latest research. Each subject downloads on its own. Notes are our own summaries with sources; updated regularly.
